decisions.reason: The selected detail-and-features reference does not change the existing task to apply the separately specified raw-graffiti style to the three characters.
Message 90 selects a reference for character details and features, while the visual-style target and traits were separately established by messages 87 and 89.
Choosing a character detail reference does not alter the requirement to restore shadows from earlier renders.
The character detail reference does not change script authority, storyboard mismatch handling, or shot-direction communication.
The selected character detail reference does not change the pair count, participating characters, or wide-to-close framing progression.
Message 90 concerns character detail fidelity and does not resolve or change SQ12 shot angles, frame selection, or frame count.
Selecting a character-image reference does not change animation as the primary presentation medium.
The character detail reference does not affect set-image resolution, quality-driven angle changes, or generation of new set images.
The selected character detail reference does not change which bridges must be removed or retained in Kestrel images.
Message 90 does not alter SQ11 shot-angle authority, frame requirements, or the shot-specification method.
The character detail reference has no necessary effect on SQ4 shot angles, frame counts, or storyboard-mismatch specifications.
Message 90 concerns a character detail target and does not change the deferred SQ4 energy-blast work.
